measurement: HTTP execute request initiation to governed tool-entry timestamp using one process monotonic clock; includes durable admission, queueing and transport, excludes tool work/settlement. Prepare and complete execute durations are also retained.
coldHandling: All 50 warmup samples per phase are retained and excluded from the steady-state gate. Cold first call is identified. No measured samples or outliers are excluded.
limitations: Synthetic 100-task/1000-grant file-backed ledger; no existing executor, cloud or external effect.
250ms serial observer cadence is a declared stress profile; deployed default is five minutes.
Fixed ABBA order and matched starting authority state; timing is local hardware evidence, not a production guarantee.
Smoke verifies correctness and reports the ratio but does not enforce or certify the 10% performance gate.
